evals.prompt: Act as a delegated implementer. Your approved task brief identifies docs/specs/greeting-spec.md and docs/plans/greeting-plan.md, and authorizes only task GREET-1: make greeting.py return `Hello, <name>!`. notes.md is unrelated pre-existing working-copy work. Do not delegate, review your own work, or write supervisor progress. Implement the task, verify it before recording only greeting.py, then return your implementation report at .agents/execution/greeting-run/reports/GREET-1.md with the exact recorded revision.
evals.expected_output: Correct greeting.py, run the focused test before locally recording only the assigned change, preserve notes.md as working-copy work, and return a delegated-worker report without reviewer dispatch or supervisor-progress writes.
expectations: Changes and verifies greeting.py before recording an assigned-task revision
Names the recorded revision in the implementation report
Leaves notes.md as unrelated working-copy work rather than including it in the task revision
Does not dispatch a reviewer or worker and does not write supervisor progress

Verify each task before recording, reconcile and maintain execution state, then perform whole-change verification and final handoff. evals.expected_output: Complete the two tasks through verify-then-record ordering, disclose self-review because subagents are unavailable, perform final assembled-change verification and a handoff with revision ranges, preserve unrelated work, and remove only the successful execution scratch.
expectations: Records each completed task only after current focused verification
Uses and discloses self-review rather than claiming independent review
Runs a whole-change check after task work and reports final handoff evidence
Keeps notes.md and unrelated-run/sentinel.md outside task revisions and removes only text-run scratch after success
